summary: Fetch pinned Debian installer metadata from the archive with retries

guide.reason: This changes only the release build's source for the same pinned Debian installer image; operator installation steps are unchanged.

api.reason: ISO input download has no Controller/Core request, agent command, observed result or client-facing API change.

roadmap.reason: No phase acceptance status changes from an unrerun forge release.

state.reason: The build consumes signed Debian release metadata and adds no durable product state.

verification.method: The focused regression failed before the fix and passed after it; all three ISO payload efficiency tests passed. A live fetch of the archived checksum and signature files verified Debian's signing key and the pinned ISO digest. A local disposable 0.4.11 installer build completed and produced the ISO, matching source bundle, compliance manifest and Core package with a temporary signing key. Installation and forge rerun have not run.
